This section reorganises the supplied **Spring Cloud Microservices Architecture** course into concept-based chapters, rather than four day-based folders. It follows the course's **shop application** with product, order, and user services as a recurring example.

::: {.callout-important}
## Historical course material

The uploaded source teaches specific Spring Cloud implementations, including Eureka, Ribbon, Feign, Hystrix, Zuul, Sleuth, Stream, Config, Consul, Sentinel, and Apollo. Treat the included APIs and configuration examples as **course-era material**, not automatically as current production recommendations. Versions and migrations need separate verification before implementing them.
:::

## Study method

Each future lesson will begin with the problem faced by the same order, product, and user services; introduce the relevant concept; demonstrate the solution; and then examine trade-offs and failure conditions. This initial commit creates an **outline only**: it does not copy the source PDF text or claim to contain updated executable examples.

## Source mapping

- **Day 1 PDF:** architectural foundations, shop case study, Eureka, Consul, Ribbon.
- **Day 2 PDF:** Feign, load testing, Hystrix, Sentinel.
- **Day 3 PDF:** Nginx, Zuul, Spring Cloud Gateway, Sleuth, Zipkin.
- **Day 4 PDF:** Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Config, Spring Cloud Bus, Apollo.

The uploaded ZIP also includes sample projects and configuration files, which can be consulted when developing individual lessons later.
